title: Profit Centers
subtitle: Profit and loss of fattening, breeding and dairy — and the farm's general income and costs

hint.method: Income and running cost are for the period. An animal's purchase price or birth value counts as cost only when it is sold (like the accounting P&L); in between it is shown as value added.
hint.calf_value: Calf value is internal: breeding income and the calf's opening value. It does not change the farm total's cash.
hint.general: General: income and costs no animal carries (dung, held expenses, manual journal entries, write-offs).
hint.type_filter: When an animal type is selected, the farm general column is hidden.
